dcf_analysis.note: Multi-stage FCFF off FY25 FCF of 4.53B. High-stage growth 16% decaying to 8%, transition taper to 3.5% terminal. Net cash of 1.32B added back. Cash-flow-based view sees upside because reported FCF dwarfs GAAP earnings (large SBC add-back). AI lens: Now Assist / agentic upsell supports the high-growth schedule; offsetting ITSM-commoditization risk is captured in the bear path (13% high-growth, +100bps WACC).

owner_earnings_analysis.details: Owner earnings: 1.55B (NI 1.748B + D&A 0.738B - Capex 0.911B - WC change 0.029B). Discount 10%, 12% 5y growth, 3% GDP-capped terminal. Buffett-style start from GAAP net income heavily penalizes ServiceNow's stock-based-comp-loaded cost structure; this is the most conservative of the four methods and a deliberate downside anchor.

ev_ebitda_analysis.note: FY25 EBITDA 3.022B (EBIT 2.284B + D&A 0.738B). Rule applies lower of own-history (~30x for high-growth SaaS) and clean mature-peer median (12.9x: CRM 12.9, WDAY 21.0, ADBE 8.7; excluded DDOG/TEAM/PANW whose near-zero GAAP EBITDA distorts the ratio). Peer-floor of 12.9x is punitive for a 22%-revenue-grower but is the rule-compliant figure.

residual_income_analysis.note: Edwards-Bell-Ohlson: BV 11.37/sh + PV of residual income at normalized forward ROE 20% vs CoE 9.14%, full retention, 10y horizon + 3% fading terminal. Positive excess returns lift value well above book but not to current price.

data_gaps: Owner-earnings and EV/EBITDA methods start from GAAP figures that understate ServiceNow's economic earnings due to heavy stock-based compensation; the cash-flow-based DCF gives a materially higher value, so the four-method spread (33 to 193) is wide. Three of four methods sit below price, driving a bearish aggregate despite a bullish DCF.
Peer EV/EBITDA set narrowed to CRM/WDAY/ADBE; high-growth peers (DDOG/TEAM/PANW/SNOW) excluded because near-zero or negative GAAP EBITDA makes their multiples non-meaningful.
